skill.name: wechat-article-search-api-skill
skill.description: Search WeChat public articles through the BrowserAct API with keywords, result limits, and publication dates. It returns article links, authors, dates, titles, images, and full text.
skill.summary: Search WeChat articles and return structured full-text results through BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick and reconnaissance detections are false positives from documentation formatting. The skill does perform real BrowserAct API calls, reads an API key, and runs a local Python script. The main concerns are instructions that ask users to provide an API key to the agent and language about avoiding CAPTCHA or geo-blocking controls.

remediation.issue: Credential collection guidance asks users to provide an API key to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through environment variables or a secret manager only. Remove instructions that ask users to paste keys into chat.

remediation.issue: The script sends authorization headers and search parameters to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Document exactly what data is sent to BrowserAct and require user consent before running the workflow.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs the agent to run a local Python command.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command arguments separate and quoted. Avoid shell interpolation when passing user keywords or date filters.

remediation.issue: Feature text frames the service as avoiding CAPTCHA and geo-blocking.
remediation.suggestion: Replace this language with compliance-focused wording and remind users to follow platform terms and content rights.

content.value_statement: WeChat article research is hard to automate reliably. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to return structured article content for analysis.
actual_capabilities: Runs the BrowserAct WeChat Article Search workflow from a local Python script.
Accepts keywords, result limits, and optional publication date filters.
Polls task status until the BrowserAct workflow finishes or times out.
Returns article titles, links, authors, dates, cover images, and full body content.
Reports authorization errors and connection failures in terminal output.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key in the BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable.
Sends search parameters and the API token to BrowserAct over the network.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow availability and WeChat source accessibility.
Does not verify copyright, licensing, or permission for collected article content.

use_cases.title: Monitor Brand Mentions
use_cases.description: Track full WeChat articles that mention a brand, product, or executive for review and reporting.

use_cases.title: Research Media Coverage
use_cases.description: Collect article text, dates, authors, and source links for media analysis across WeChat public accounts.

use_cases.title: Build Topic Briefs
use_cases.description: Gather structured WeChat articles for trend summaries, knowledge bases, or sentiment review workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Keyword Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a single topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to search WeChat articles for "electric vehicles". Return useful titles, dates, authors, and summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Date
prompt_templates.scenario: Narrow a search with a date and small limit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search WeChat for "AI agent" with a limit of 5 and publication date "2026-03-11". Include source links.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitor Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyze several companies in one research task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search WeChat for three competitor names. Group results by competitor and note repeated themes across articles.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Analysis Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect up to 20 WeChat articles about "battery recycling" from March 2026. Return fields for sentiment review and citation.

output_examples.input: Search for WeChat articles about AI agents.
output: A short list of matching article titles with publication dates and authors.
Full article body content returned by BrowserAct.
Source links that support follow-up review.

output_examples.input: Monitor brand exposure for a product launch.
output_examples.output: The response includes relevant WeChat articles, publishing accounts, dates, links, and body content for communications review.

output_examples.input: Build a brief from WeChat articles about battery recycling.
output_examples.output: The result groups articles by topic and includes source details for citation and sentiment analysis.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment before using the skill.
Start with a small result limit to confirm query quality.
Review collected article content for source rights and privacy requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not use broad keywords when a narrow phrase is available.
Do not treat extracted article text as licensed for reuse without review.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to call the BrowserAct workflow.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide keywords, a result limit, and an optional publication date filter.

faq.question: What does the skill return?
faq.answer: It can return article links, titles, authors, dates, cover images, and body content.

faq.question: Can it run without network access?
faq.answer: No. It calls the BrowserAct API and polls task status until completion.

faq.question: Does it scrape WeChat directly?
faq.answer: No. The included script calls a BrowserAct workflow template instead of direct local scraping.

faq.question: How should I handle credentials?
faq.answer: Store the API key in an environment variable or secret manager. Do not paste the key into chat.
